alignments.note: Waw takes the *And* written for it under rule 14.
Explicit subject pronoun takes only its own English word under rule 20; the verb keeps its auxiliary and lexical verb.
Finite verb with its future auxiliary under rule 17, headed on the lexical verb.
The definite direct-object marker has no English realization here; the ASV writes the object bare, so it is unrepresented under rule 16.
Proper name as the verb's object.
Preposition takes the *From* written for it under rule 11.
Quantifying construct noun keeps only its own word; the ASV writes no *of* between the two nouns for rule 19 to place.
Nomen rectum, rendered without a relational word.
Possessive suffix under rule 18; the English fronts it before the noun, which rule 25 allows.

review_notes: The pronoun הוּא is explicit and takes only *he*, with the auxiliary and lexical verb staying on יִפְדֶּה under rules 17 and 20.
